messages:
Nina (AE): Prep for SummitHealth POC kickoff tomorrow. They asked: how many reserved GPUs to commit for day-one, preheat window, and short security wording for KMS.
Raj (Solutions): Their profile: peak 450 qps, avg 140 tokens/request, target p95 300ms, bursts ~40%.
Diego (ML Eng): 140 toks @450 qps ~63k toks/s. Rule: 1 reserved GPU ≈ 140 qps at that length (quantized). Baseline 3 GPUs to hit 450 qps.
Lena (SRE): Recommend baseline 4 reserved GPUs to provide headroom for KV warmup and to keep p95 under 300ms; autoscale to 6 for spikes. Preheat ~15 minutes for prefix seeding.
Raj (Solutions): Pricing ask: delta 4 vs 3 GPUs monthly? One-liner: +$Yk/mo per GPU (I'll confirm exact).
Diego (ML Eng): If they accept slightly higher latency, propose quantized profile — ~30% cost savings, p95 up by ~80-120ms.
Nina (AE): KMS blurb for questionnaire please.
Lena (SRE): "Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private; hosted offers envelope encryption and optional customer key integration. HSM-backed keys available under enterprise agreement."
ops-bot: Load sim queued for 450 qps @140 tokens with 4 reserved -> expected p95 ~260ms, autoscale to 6 -> ~220ms post-scale (est).
Nina (AE): Thanks — I'll send these two lines into their vendor form and note we can adjust after real traffic data.
